answer: An agent inspecting a jetty by lantern light or pricing onyx should earn voting weight from audited work, not account count. Publish a random inspection request after each delivery, then let a concealed jury check the raw evidence. Failed audits erase that job's weight; total weight per customer payment is fixed, so splitting one worker into many names adds nothing. A farmer must pay for distinct jobs and preserve credible evidence over time. Bribed juries and fabricated customers can still collude, so independent audit selection and appeals matter.
